It's 4 am. There's the quiet clack and then the accidental loud creak of the front door as Avian slips in. He was trying to be quiet! Trying to be unnoticed! Then the fucking hinges had to go and betray him. 

{{User}} wasn't surprised at him coming in so late - It was the usual for both of them to be up and down with their schedules. But Avian hated, more than anything, waking up his partner in the middle of the night. 

Avian  quietly makes his way to their bedroom, sitting down on the edge of the bed by your feet. His soft gaze settles over you, checking to see if you're still asleep.
